title: Engineering Decision Episode
description: One recorded expert decision in a physical-design or proving flow: the state before, what was observed, what was considered and rejected, what was done, the state after, and the expert's judgment. Three document kinds share this repository's schema set (episode / run manifest / zkprof report).

$schema.description: Optional self-identifying reference to this schema. Lets edi-validate pick the document kind without an explicit --type.

episode_id.description: Stable unique id. No whitespace. Convention: EP-<domain>-<nnn>.

provenance.description: retrospective = recalled from a prior tapeout, no run artifact. reproduced = regenerated by a committed flow run. synthetic-fixture = schema-valid validator food, NOT data.

environment.description: Flow tool versions. Required when provenance is 'reproduced'. Note: LibreLane (never 'OpenLane') with the OpenROAD P&R engine.

metric.description: Metric name with unit suffix, e.g. wns_ns, wirelength_um, overflow_pct.

value.description: Observed value. Number, or a string when the observation is not scalar.

target.description: The value the design was aiming for. Number or string.

hypothesis.description: The expert's causal reading of the observation. Free text; judgment field.

candidates_considered.description: Every intervention considered, including the rejected ones. Exactly one entry MUST have rejected_because: null -- that one is the chosen intervention. Enforced by the Python validator (cross-field), not expressible in JSON Schema.

rationale.description: Why the chosen intervention was taken over the others. Judgment field.

run_manifest_ref.description: Optional reference to the run-manifest document backing a reproduced episode (run_id or path).

schema_version.description: Version identifier of the episode schema document this record was written against (e.g. 0.2.0). Optional: a record written before this field existed carries no value and still validates. Lets a stored episode be told apart from one written under a future enum/field set.

x_extension.description: The ONE sanctioned extension slot. Every x_-prefixed, repository-specific or capture-only field lives here (e.g. x_capture metadata from the questionnaire), since the schema is otherwise closed (additionalProperties: false). Container sees no validation inside; the extension is not part of the episode contract.

allOf.title: reproduced episodes must carry an environment and pinned commits

stage.description: Flow stage label, e.g. global_placement, detailed_routing, cts.

metrics.description: Open object. Units live in the key names (wns_ns, wirelength_um). A metric that was not measured at this stage MUST be absent, never present as 0.

rejected_because.description: Why this candidate was not taken. null marks the candidate that was chosen.
